user.title: Device Builder
user.description: Where the ESPHome Device Builder runs.

data_description.url: The Device Builder's base URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:6052.
data_description.username: Only needed if the Device Builder asks for a login.
data_description.password: Only needed if the Device Builder asks for a login.

configuration.title: Tracked Config
configuration.description: The ESPHome configuration to watch for updates.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Device Builder.
error.invalid_auth: The Device Builder refused the username or password.
error.unsupported_version: This Device Builder version is not supported.

abort.no_configurations: The Device Builder has no configurations.

unsupported_server_version.title: Unsupported Device Builder for {title}
unsupported_server_version.description: The Device Builder that compiles {title} reports version {server_version}, which ESPHome Git Updates does not support. Updates for {title} are paused until the Device Builder runs a supported version or this integration is updated.

unexpected_frame.title: Unexpected answer from the Device Builder for {title}
unexpected_frame.description: The Device Builder that compiles {title} sent something ESPHome Git Updates does not understand, so updates for {title} are paused. This usually means the Device Builder changed its protocol. Details: {error}
